newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India tenders to buy 1.0 mln bbls June crude oil.
newsitem.headline: India tenders to buy 1.0 mln bbls June crude oil.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has issued a tender to buy one million barrels of June loading crude oil, traders said on Monday.
The tender closes at 0800 hours Indian Standard Time (0230 GMT) on April 24 and offers should be valid until 2200 hours (1630 GMT) on April 25.
IOC is seeking its usual monthly crude purchases in the tender, including Middle East, West African and Asian crude grades.
In its May tender, IOC purchased five cargoes of Suez Blend, and three very large crude carriers of Qua Iboe.
Unusually, IOC did not purchase any Dubai cargoes.
